description: Global potential hydropower locations is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Hoes O.A.C.. The dataset contains all potential hydropower plant locations for micro to large hydropower plants based on the GMTED2010 breakline dataset (elevation) and runoff data from the Global Runoff Data Centre. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2014. Formats: ZIP. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is 4TU General Terms of Use. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
